A '''listening post''' was operated by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-controlled [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].

==History==
{{Quote|The SIS hid behind the slicer gang. But why? Maybe to disguise a listening post... maybe they're listening to us right now!|Keeling draws a connection between local slicers and the SIS|<ref name="TWHE" />}}
By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="3643BBY" /> the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]], the primary [[Spy/Legends|intelligence]] agency of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Sith Wars/Legends|Sith Wars]],<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Strategic Information Service}}</ref> emplaced a [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] in a building in the [[Corellian Sector (Nar Shaddaa)/Legends|Corellian Sector]] on the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-controlled [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to monitor [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] transmissions. To conceal this post's presence, the SIS relayed stolen reports to the [[Krayts]], a local [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] gang, who offered to sell the reports on the black market.<ref name="TWHE" /> After local [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] [[Ghost (Neimoidian)|Ghost]] revealed to Imperial heroes the gang had sliced into Imperial databases and stolen sensitive reports, the heroes recovered the reports and delivered them to [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Keeling]].<ref name="LtVB">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Let the Vendor Beware|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref> Keeling discovered the reports bore SIS slicing signatures along with coordinates to the their listening post and dispatched the heroes to destroy the post's comm terminal.<ref name="TWHE" /> At least ten SIS personnel were defeated in the attack on the listening post.<ref name="SitLP">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Silence in the Listening Post|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic Listening Post appeared as a story area for all four Imperial player character classes on Nar Shaddaa in the [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in [[2011]].<ref name="TWHE" />
